claims.statement: langgraph.json registers five graphs (agent, reviewer, analyzer, chat, scheduler) by import path and mounts the FastAPI app agent.webapp:app as the platform HTTP app that owns webhooks and the dashboard API.

langgraph.json configures a checkpointer TTL policy with the delete strategy, a 60-minute sweep interval, and a default TTL of 43200 minutes, and points the platform at the .env file for environment variables.

SANDBOX_TYPE selects the sandbox backend and defaults to langsmith; create_sandbox resolves it against the SANDBOX_FACTORIES registry (langsmith, daytona, modal, runloop, e2b, local) and raises ValueError listing supported types for an unknown value.

validate_sandbox_startup_config runs from the FastAPI lifespan hook so an invalid sandbox-provider configuration fails at server boot rather than at first sandbox creation, delegating to LangSmithProvider.validate_startup_config for the langsmith provider.

For SANDBOX_TYPE=langsmith the base snapshot defaults to DEFAULT_SANDBOX_SNAPSHOT_ID and per-sandbox resources are tuned with optional env vars whose defaults are 128 GiB FS (DEFAULT_SANDBOX_SNAPSHOT_FS_CAPACITY_BYTES), 4 vCPUs (DEFAULT_SANDBOX_VCPUS), 16 GiB memory (DEFAULT_SANDBOX_MEM_BYTES), 7200s idle TTL (DEFAULT_SANDBOX_IDLE_TTL_SECONDS; 0 disables), and 2592000s delete-after-stop (DEFAULT_SANDBOX_DELETE_AFTER_STOP_SECONDS; 0 disables).

DEFAULT_SANDBOX_SNAPSHOT_ID is only the deployment default; an admin can override the base snapshot at runtime through GET/PUT /dashboard/api/sandbox-settings, and resolve_base_snapshot_id encodes the precedence admin-setting-then-env so the change rolls out without a redeploy.

get_sandbox_settings reports the stored admin snapshot, the env snapshot, the resolved effective snapshot, and a base_snapshot_source of admin, env, or unset; the stored base_snapshot_id is opaque provider-scoped free text validated only for a 512-character maximum length.

LLM_FALLBACK_MODEL_ID sets an explicit fallback model, defaulting to a provider-appropriate fallback_model_id_for(model_id) when unset, and a ModelFallbackMiddleware is wired only when the fallback differs from the primary model.

Model calls carry a provider-level per-request timeout defaulting to DEFAULT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (600s) with DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES (6) retries, applied to the openai, anthropic, baseten, google_genai, and fireworks providers so a stalled connection retries instead of parking a run.

RUN_COMPLETE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is a shared bearer token proving a /webhooks/run-complete call came from Open SWE's own dispatch, and verify_run_complete_token fails closed by rejecting every call when the secret is unset, disabling completion and failure replies until it is configured.

TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY encrypts stored GitHub tokens and accepts an ordered, most-recent-first list of Fernet keys so writes use the first key while reads try each key in order, enabling rotation without invalidating already-stored tokens.

The ENV registry centralizes application environment variables and reads values lazily; blank values are unset, canonical names win over aliases, typed accessors parse integers, booleans and lists, and undeclared names fail explicitly.

FastAPI lifespan pins a single event loop, validates the GitHub login allowlist, sandbox configuration, and localhost development model credentials before serving; analytics initialization is nonfatal, and shutdown stops analytics and closes cached model clients. create_app rejects a wildcard DASHBOARD_ALLOWED_ORIGINS because it configures credentialed CORS.

Team settings are a single instance-wide Store record; input validates model-and-effort pairs, Store read failures degrade to hardcoded defaults, chat inherits the agent model, and review grouping inherits the reviewer subagent model when unset or invalid.

Gateway routing uses explicit LANGSMITH_GATEWAY_ENABLED when set and otherwise enables when LANGSMITH_GATEWAY_API_KEY is set; a true or false team value overrides this default, whereas an unset value inherits it, and unavailable routing logs and falls back to direct provider calls.
Dispatch attaches no run-completion webhook when COMPLETION_WEBHOOK_URL is relative or loopback, even with a completion secret, so a platform-rejected callback cannot break run creation.

An environment definition persists scripts, prompt, repositories, sandbox resource overrides, and safe create parameters; runs select it from the dashboard or an env:<name> Slack tag, otherwise use default, and fall back to the base snapshot when no ready environment exists.

Environment create parameters are serialized-size bounded and reject credential-like fields and authorization headers, while persisted environment records revalidate those parameters before passing them to sandbox creation.

Environment full refreshes run setup and update scripts on a throwaway builder before capture, incremental refreshes run only update from the current snapshot, and script or capture failures retain the prior usable snapshot.

When an environment snapshot is stale, sandbox creation runs its update script before the first model call and queues a background refresh; update execution failures are logged but do not fail the run.

Environment snapshots publish a latest tag but runs use the recorded immutable snapshot ID; a capture in progress preserves the previous ready ID, preventing a refresh from changing a running or reconnecting sandbox image.

CONFIGURED_ADMINS compares normalized configured GitHub logins or emails with session identities, while administrative sandbox-settings routes also accept an admin GitHub bearer token or an allowlisted GitHub Actions OIDC token.

User preferences are keyed by login and fail soft to private visibility with no tracing-project override when Store lookup fails; user instructions are separately keyed by login and nonblank instructions are appended to the main agent prompt for that user's runs.
